title.zh: Google invests millions in Mark Zuckerberg’s efforts to create a ‘virtual cell’
title.en: Google invests millions in Mark Zuckerberg’s efforts to create a ‘virtual cell’

current_state.zh: Google DeepMind, Meta, and Isomorphic Labs are jointly investing $300 million into the Chan Zuckerberg-founded nonprofit Biohub as part of a $1.8 billion effort to build AI datasets enabling 'virtual cell' models for biomedical research.
current_state.en: Google DeepMind, Meta, and Isomorphic Labs are jointly investing $300 million into the Chan Zuckerberg-founded nonprofit Biohub as part of a $1.8 billion effort to build AI datasets enabling 'virtual cell' models for biomedical research.
